LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynDialog: Oh, it's so nice to see you today, dear! Make sure you take a break and smell the flowers, won't you? It's good for the soul.
I was just thinking about baking some of my special cookies. George always complains about the kitchen getting too warm, but he's the first one to ask for a warm batch!
Hello there, young one! The flowers in the town square are doing wonderfully today. I hope the crops on your farm are thriving just as much.
My poor George has been a little more sour than usual today. Don't take it to heart if he barks at you, dear... he really does appreciate your visits.
Granny's bones always ache a bit more when the weather is about to turn. Make sure you dress warmly if you're going to be out late, won't you?
It's so wonderful to see the town looking lively today. Oh, and don't forget to eat a hearty meal, honey! Farming is hard work.
Sundays are always so peaceful. I just finished writing a little letter to an old friend. Make sure you keep in touch with your loved ones, dear.
Spring is my absolute favorite season, dear. New life is blooming everywhere you look!
Oh, it's getting dreadfully hot out there! Make sure you drink plenty of water, young one. You don't want to overwork yourself in this heat.
The leaves are changing beautifully this year. I've been pressing a few of the prettiest ones in my books.
Brrr! It's so chilly! I hope you have a nice, warm hearth to return to on the farm, dear.
Mondays always feel like a fresh start, don't they? I hope your week is off to a beautiful beginning, dear.
I've been thinking about trying a new cookie recipe, but George is quite set in his ways. Perhaps I'll make a small batch just for myself... and you!
Halfway through the week already! Goodness, time flies when you're busy in the garden.
Have you seen my reading glasses, young one? Oh, wait... they're on my head. How silly of Granny!
The weekend is almost here! Though I suppose on a farm, the work never truly stops, does it?
It's a lovely Friday afternoon. I'm just enjoying the peace and quiet before the town gets rowdy tonight.
I love Saturdays. I get to see so many of the townsfolk out and about.
Make sure you rest this weekend if you can, honey. Even the hardest worker needs a day off.
A quiet Sunday morning is just the thing for an old woman like me. It's so peaceful.
Are you ready for the week ahead, dear? Just take it one day at a time.
The spring rain is wonderful for my tulips, but do make sure you don't catch a cold out there!
Look at all this new life around us. Spring is truly Yoba's gift to the valley.
I'm hoping to see a little more sunshine this weekend, but the plants won't mind the rain.
Oh my, the heat is certainly picking up. Stop by if you ever need a cool glass of water, dear.
George is so fussy when it's hot out. I've had to make extra trips to fetch him ice for his drinks!
The summer evenings are so beautiful, aren't they? The fireflies remind me of when I was a little girl.
The crisp air is so refreshing! Fall has always been a special time for George and me.
I'll be starting on my holiday knitting soon. I like to get a head start!
The fall harvest must keep you so busy, young one. Make sure you're eating enough of it!
Brrr! The old bones don't much like the cold, but the snow is very pretty from the window.
George and I haven't been out much this week. The ice is just too dangerous for his chair.
I put a little extra wood in the stove this morning. Nothing beats a warm fire on a snowy weekend.
Spring is in the air now! My garden is finally waking from its winter sleep.
Ah, the 14th! Time goes by so quickly... Make sure you appreciate every moment.
Tomorrow is George's clinic appointment. He always gets so grumpy about going to see Doctor Harvey.
The last day of Spring! Make sure your fields are cleared out for Summer, young one.
It's so humid already. Be careful not to work out in the sun too long.
The midpoint of summer... The days are so long and bright, but they pass by in a flash.
Oh, it's almost Fall. The town will be changing colors before we know it.
The leaves are really starting to turn now. Such beautiful shades of red and gold!
I should ask George to help me pick some apples. Oh, but his knees... maybe I'll ask Alex instead.
We're nearing the end of another year. Have you achieved what you set out to do, dear?
It's George's birthday today! I made him some fried mushrooms, his favorite.
The first few days of winter always feel so quiet and still.
The town is so festive this time of year! It always brings a smile to my face.
Almost my birthday... though at my age, you stop wanting to count them!
The year is winding down. Rest up, dear, for another spring is just around the corner.
Oh, the spring breeze is so refreshing today! It's the perfect weather for a stroll in the garden, don't you think?
Fourteen days of spring already... The season is just flying by! I've been busy tidying up the flower beds in the square.
The flowers are in full bloom now, dear. It makes my old heart so happy to see all this color in the valley.
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgeDialog: It's Monday again. Bah. Just another day of staring at this screen.
Hmmph. Evelyn is baking again. The whole house smells like sugar... I'm not complaining, though.
You look like you've been working hard. Hmm. Nothing wrong with breaking a sweat.
Don't stand in front of the television set. The Tunnelers are on in five minutes!
Hmph. The town always gets so noisy on Fridays. I prefer it quiet.
Alex is out throwing that ball around again. Kid's got energy, I'll give him that.
I used to hate the weekends... Too many people around. But I don't mind when you drop by, kid.
Sundays are for resting. Though I've been resting for years now... Hmph.
I complained to Evelyn about the draft in here, and she just handed me a sweater. Bah.
You're a reliable one, you know that? We don't get many hard workers like you around here anymore.
Spring is wet. Wet means my knees act up. Why do people like this season again?
Look at all this mud everywhere... Hope you wiped your shoes before coming in.
Evelyn is driving me crazy with her flower talk... Hmmph. Though I suppose they do smell nice.
Bah! The TV signal is acting up again. Just my luck.
It's too hot today. The air in this valley gets thicker than chowder.
Hmmph. Someone sent me a letter about a new brand of television. Sounds like a scam to me.
I told Alex to drink more water out there. Kids these days don't listen to a lick of sense.
The summer's almost over... Good riddance. The heat is unbearable.
Fall is the only season I can tolerate. The air is crisp... Reminds me of the old days.
Hmm... I can smell Evelyn cooking something. Smells like mushrooms. Don't tell her I said that.
I saw the Mayor earlier today. Hmph. He talks too much.
Tomorrow is the start of winter... Make sure you've got enough wood for your fire, kid.
My legs feel like icicles today. *Grumble*... It's miserable.
When I was younger, I used to shovel the snow for the whole block. Now... well... hmph.
Bah! Everyone's running around talking about the Feast. I'd rather just watch my shows in peace.
Tomorrow is my wife's birthday. I got her something small... She better appreciate it.
I might be a grouch, but even I can appreciate a hot bowl of soup on a day like this.
Hmph... You really don't have anywhere better to be right now? Go enjoy the holiday, kid.
Another year gone... They fly by faster the older you get. Don't waste 'em.
I heard you've been planting parsnips. Hmph. A sturdy crop, if you don't overwater it.
If you find any leeks out there, you know who to bring 'em to. Just sayin'.
Bah! Tomorrow is that clinic appointment. Harvey doesn't know a thing about a bad knee.
The TV said there's going to be a good documentary on later tonight about mining. Hmph, maybe I'll learn something.
I used to be quite the swimmer in my youth. Hard to believe now, isn't it? Hmph.
A farmer's work is never done... At least that's what my grand-pap used to say.
Did you harvest any pumpkins yet? Evelyn wants to make a pie, and I wouldn't mind a slice.
Hmph. I thought I saw a ghost outside my window last night... Probably just my old eyes playing tricks.
It's my birthday tomorrow. Don't think I'm making a big fuss about it... Bah.
Ah, another year older. My joints feel it the most. Hmph.
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynTulipQ: Hello dear,^^I was just looking around the living room and realized it could use a little splash of color.^^If you happen to grow any Tulips on your farm, could you bring one to an old lady? It would bring such joy to my heart.^^- Evelyn^^%item quest LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynTulipQuest%%[#]Letter from Evelyn

ItemDelivery/Tulip Season/Evelyn would like a fresh Tulip to brighten up her living room./Bring Evelyn 1 Tulip./Evelyn (O)591 1/-1/100/-1/true/Oh, what a beautiful tulip! The color is just lovely.#$b#Thank you so much for bringing this to me, dear.$h
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynFairyR: My dear,^^I was hoping to press some Fairy Roses for my albums this year. If you could harvest some and bring me one of them, I'd be incredibly grateful.^^- Evelyn^^%item quest LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynFairyRoseQuest%%[#]Letter from Evelyn

ItemDelivery/Rose Pressing/Evelyn would like to press some Fairy Roses for her albums and is asking for one./Bring Evelyn 1 Fairy Rose./Evelyn (O)595 1/-1/1500/-1/true/Oh, this is simply gorgeous! The petals are so delicate.#$b#I'll get to pressing these right away. Thank you, dear!$l
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynChocol: Hello dear,^^I was just thinking about how much George and I love a good Chocolate Cake, but I haven't had the energy to bake one lately.^^If you happen to have one, could you bring it by? We would love to split it and share a nice treat.^^- Evelyn^^%item quest LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynChocolateCakeQuest%%[#]Letter from Evelyn

ItemDelivery/Sweet Treat/Evelyn would like a Chocolate Cake to share with George./Bring Evelyn 1 Chocolate Cake./Evelyn (O)220 1/-1/500/-1/true/Oh, my! It smells absolutely delicious.#$b#George will be so thrilled to share this with me. Thank you for the wonderful treat!$h
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgeFreshL: Hey kid,^^Do me a favor. I've been craving a good, crisp Leek from the mountains.^^If you're out foraging and find one, bring it by. I don't get out as much as I used to.^^- George^^%item quest LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgeFreshLeekQuest%%[#]Letter from George

ItemDelivery/Spring Craving/George is craving a fresh Leek from the mountains./Bring George 1 Leek./George (O)20 1/-1/200/-1/true/Bah, it took you long enough. Joking... it looks like a good one. Thanks, kid.$h
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgeStoneQ: Kid,^^The winds are picking up and there's a draft in the house that's driving me crazy.^^I need to patch a hole in the foundation. Bring me a piece of Stone if you have any to spare.^^- George^^%item quest LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgeStoneQuest%%[#]Letter from George

ItemDelivery/Fixing the Draft/George needs Stone to fix a drafty spot in his house./Bring George 1 Stone./George (O)390 1/-1/100/-1/true/Good, this should do the trick. Now maybe my knees will stop freezing.$h
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgeFriedM: Kid,^^I can smell Evelyn cooking, but she won't make one of my favorites.^^If you happen to get your hands on a Fried Mushroom, bring it to me on the sly. Don't tell my wife.^^- George^^%item quest LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgeFriedMushroomQuest%%[#]Letter from George

ItemDelivery/Secret Snack/George wants a Fried Mushroom and doesn't want Evelyn to know./Bring George 1 Fried Mushroom./George (O)205 1/-1/500/-1/true/Hmph. Not as good as the ones Evelyn used to make, but it'll do. Thanks.$h
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynCuteLe: Oh my dear,^^I was just baking a fresh batch of cookies. I hope you're taking good care of yourself out on that farm! Make sure you find time to rest.^^- Evelyn^^%item id (O)223 3 %%[#]Note from Evelyn

Dearest,^^The rain outside always makes my old joints ache, but I know it's wonderful for the gardens! I had an extra slice of cake left over and wanted to share it with my favorite neighbor.^^- Evelyn^^%item id (O)221 1 %%[#]Note from Evelyn
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgeCuteLe: Evelyn made me write this. She said we haven't seen you around as much lately. Don't go thinking I actually miss you, but... if you're ever in the neighborhood, I guess you could drop by. Keep your chimney lit, it's freezing out there.^^- George^^%item id (O)382 5 %%[#]Note from George
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynFreshC: Dearest,^^I was sitting by the fire today, thinking about when George and I were first courting. He used to brave the cold to bring me a wild Crocus.^^If you happen to find one out in the snow, could you bring it to me? I'd simply love to see those gentle petals again.^^- Evelyn^^%item quest LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynFreshCrocusQuest%%[#]Letter from Evelyn

ItemDelivery/Winter Memory/Evelyn is remembering her youth and would like a wild Crocus./Bring Evelyn 1 Crocus./Evelyn (O)418 1/-1/300/-1/true/Oh, my... it's just as beautiful as I remember.#$b#Thank you, dear. You've made an old woman very happy today.$h
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynSugarQ: Hello honey,^^Granny was right in the middle of making a big batch of cookies for Vincent and Jas, and silly me! I completely ran out of Sugar.^^If you have a spare bag, could you bring it over? I know the little ones are looking forward to their treats.^^- Evelyn^^%item quest LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynSugarQuest%%[#]Letter from Evelyn

ItemDelivery/Baking Emergency/Evelyn ran out of Sugar while baking cookies for the town's children./Bring Evelyn 1 Sugar./Evelyn (O)245 1/-1/200/-1/true/Oh, you're a lifesaver, dear!#$b#I can finish these up before they come over.#$b#I'll be sure to save a cookie just for you!$h
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynClothQ: My dear,^^I was looking at George's favorite sweater this morning and realized it's getting quite threadbare. I'd love to make him a new one.^^If you have some nice, spun Cloth from your farm, could you bring some by?^^- Evelyn^^%item quest LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynClothQuest%%[#]Letter from Evelyn

ItemDelivery/Warm Sweater/Evelyn wants to knit a new sweater for George and needs some Cloth./Bring Evelyn 1 Cloth./Evelyn (O)428 1/-1/600/-1/true/This fabric is wonderfully soft! George will be so snug in his new sweater.#$b#You have such a kind heart, helping me take care of him.$h
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynMelonQ: Farmer! We have a bit of a situation at the house.^^Alex invited over some friends for our family dinner this weekend and forgot to tell me until just now! I don't have enough food.^^Could you bring me one Melon as soon as possible? I need to make a massive fruit salad to feed all these hungry kids.^^- Evelyn^^%item quest LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynMelonQuest%%[#]Letter from Evelyn

ItemDelivery/Family Gathering/Evelyn needs one Melon to make a big fruit salad for a family gathering./Bring Evelyn 1 Melon./Evelyn (O)254 1/-1/400/-1/true/Oh, thank goodness you arrived when you did!#$b#I can finally start chopping these up.#$b#You really saved my evening, dear.$h
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgePaleAl: Don't say a word of this to Evelyn.^^I want a Pale Ale. I haven't had one since I sat on the porch with my old man, years before he passed away. I just... I want to remember what it tasted like. Bring me one when you have the time.^^- George^^%item quest LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgePaleAleQuest%%[#]Letter from George

ItemDelivery/Drink for Dad/George wants a Pale Ale to remember his late father./Bring George 1 Pale Ale./George (O)303 1/-1/600/-1/true/...Yeah, that's exactly how I remember it.#$b#Thanks, kid. Seriously.#$b#Now let me drink this in peace.$l
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgeWineQu: This wind is loud enough to wake the dead. It's rattling the old window panes. I can't stand it.^^Bring me a bottle of Wine so I can actually get some sleep through this racket. Evelyn's already out like a light, so just hand it over quietly.^^- George^^%item quest LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgeWineQuest%%[#]Letter from George

ItemDelivery/Sleeping Through the Storm/George wants some Wine to help him sleep through the loud, windy weather./Bring George 1 Wine./George (O)348 1/-1/800/-1/true/Finally. Took you long enough.#$b#Maybe I can actually get some shut-eye. Goodnight.$h
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynDiamon: Young one, are you awake? I had a terrible fright last night.^^I was cleaning out the old dresser and knocked my jewelry box onto the floor. The little diamond from my mother's brooch popped out and went straight down the floorboard... I've been crying over it all morning.^^Could you find a Diamond for me to replace it? I'm terribly heartbroken.^^- Evelyn^^%item quest LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynDiamondQuest%%[#]Letter from Evelyn

ItemDelivery/Broken Brooch/Evelyn lost the diamond from her mother's brooch and needs a replacement./Bring Evelyn 1 Diamond./Evelyn (O)72 1/-1/1000/-1/true/Oh, bless your soul! This is the right size.#$b#I can't thank you enough, dear.$h
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgeIridiu: They don't make parts like they used to. The left wheel on this chair has been squeaking for weeks.^^I read in an engineering magazine that iridium doesn't rust or warp under pressure. If you ever manage to smelt an Iridium Bar, bring it to me. I want to see if I can swap out these axles before I go deaf.^^- George^^%item quest LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgeIridiumQuest%%[#]Letter from George

ItemDelivery/Squeaky Wheel/George's wheelchair is squeaking and he wants an Iridium Bar to fix the axles./Bring George 1 Iridium Bar./George (O)337 1/-1/1000/-1/true/Well, look at that. Heavy and solid!#$b#This just might work.#$b#Don't think I'm not grateful, kid. I am.$h
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynChicke: Hello my dear,^^I find myself feeling quite nostalgic today. I was telling George about my childhood home, and he reminded me of that sweet, sweet little Chicken Statue my mother kept on the mantlepiece.^^If you ever unearth one in your travels, I would dearly love to have it to remember her by.^^- Evelyn^^%item quest LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynChickenStatueQuest%%[#]Letter from Evelyn

ItemDelivery/Mother's Memory/Evelyn would like a Chicken Statue for her mantle, like the one her mother used to have./Bring Evelyn 1 Chicken Statue./Evelyn (O)113 1/-1/500/-1/true/Oh my words, you actually found one! It looks exactly like my mother's.#$b#I'm going to put it on the mantle right away. Thank you, dear.$h
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgeOrname: I have a massive favor to ask, and it stays between us.^^Evelyn has been putting up with my complaints and taking care of me for more years than I can count. I want to give her something nice for a change.^^There's an old Ornamental Fan you can find buried out there. Bring one to me so I can give it to her.^^- George^^%item quest LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgeOrnamentalFanQuest%%[#]Letter from George

ItemDelivery/Gift for Evelyn/George wants an Ornamental Fan to give to Evelyn to thank her for everything she does./Bring George 1 Ornamental Fan./George (O)106 1/-1/500/-1/true/You actually brought it. It's beautiful.#$b#Evelyn is going to be so happy when she sees this.#$b#Thanks, kid. You're alright.$h
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynGiftLe: The summer sun is shining so beautifully today! I was watching the butterflies in the garden, they're so cute!^^Please, make sure you're eating properly, and enjoying life here in the valley.^^I baked a Pink Cake yesterday and saved a slice just for you!^^- Evelyn^^%item id (O)221 1 %%[#]Letter from Evelyn

It's bitter cold outside! The snow is piling up on the window sills, and it makes my joints ache just looking at it.^^I spent the afternoon baking and wanted to send you a batch of warm cookies to eat!^^- Evelyn^^%item id (O)223 3 %%[#]Letter from Evelyn
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgeGiftLe: The damp air is killing my knees today. I didn't feel like watching TV, so I just sat by the window, and I saw you run by in the rain earlier. You're going to catch your death working like a madman in this weather.^^Drink this coffee and stay inside for once.^^- George^^%item id (O)433 2 %%[#]Letter from George
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgePearlQ: Our anniversary is coming up. I want to give Evelyn something special. Decades ago, we took a ferry to the Fern Islands and the water was clear and full of pearls, and she loved it.^^I don't have the legs to make it there anymore. If you find a Pearl out there, bring it to me. I want to remind her of that trip.^^- George^^%item quest LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgePearlQuest%%[#]Letter from George

ItemDelivery/Our Anniversary/George wants to surprise Evelyn for their anniversary with a Pearl, reminding her of a trip they took to the Fern Islands./Bring George 1 Pearl./George (O)797 1/-1/2000/-1/true/You actually found one. It looks just like the ones we saw back then.#$b#She's going to love this. Thank you, kid.$h
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynAncien: My dear,^^I found my grandmother's recipe book, and saw a jam she used to make when we were kids. It was made from a blue, ancient fruit of some kind.^^It sparked such a memory... if you find an Ancient Fruit, could you bring it to me? I would love to taste that old recipe, just one last time.^^- Evelyn^^%item quest LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynAncientFruitQuest%%[#]Letter from Evelyn

ItemDelivery/Antique Recipe/Evelyn found a missing page from her grandmother's recipe book and needs an Ancient Fruit to recreate a legendary jam./Bring Evelyn 1 Ancient Fruit./Evelyn (O)454 1/-1/1500/-1/true/Oh, my stars! You really found one!#$b#I'm going to start preserving this right away. This means so much to me, dear.$h
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgeBatter: This damned storm knocked out the power to my ham radio. I've got a scheduled check-in with an old friend of mine in Zuzu City, and I don't want him thinking I've finally kicked the bucket.^^Bring me a Battery Pack so I can get this hunk of junk working again.^^- George^^%item quest LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgeBatteryQuest%%[#]Letter from George

ItemDelivery/Static Voices/A storm knocked out George's ham radio, and he needs a Battery Pack to power it back up to reach his old friend in Zuzu City./Bring George 1 Battery Pack./George (O)787 1/-1/350/-1/true/Hmph, took you a while. But it works.#$b#Now let me get back to the frequency. We'll talk later.$l
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynStarfr: I was speaking with the merchant at the cart, they told me about an exotic tea brewed from a bright yellow Starfruit. It sounded simply divine!^^If you're able to grow one of those on your farm, would you bring it over? I'll put the kettle on and we can share a pot together on the porch.^^- Evelyn^^%item quest LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynStarfruitQuest%%[#]Letter from Evelyn

ItemDelivery/Starry Brew/Evelyn wants to make an exotic Stardrop tea recipe she learned from the Traveling Cart using a Starfruit./Bring Evelyn 1 Starfruit./Evelyn (O)268 1/-1/750/-1/true/What a magnificent shape! I can almost smell the sweetness already.#$b#I'll put the water on right now, dear.$h
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgePrisma: When Alex's mother, Clara, was younger, she used to sit by the window for hours looking for rainbows after the spring rain.^^The winter days are dark without her. Bring me a Prismatic Shard. Please... Please.^^- George^^%item quest LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgePrismaticShardQuest%%[#]Letter from George

ItemDelivery/Rainbow Rays/George wants a Prismatic Shard to catch the light on the windowsill, in memory of his late daughter./Bring George 1 Prismatic Shard./George (O)74 1/-1/1000/-1/true/It's... it's perfect.#$b#The colors are just as bright as I remember.#$b#Hmph.#$b#...#$b#Evelyn and I... we used to watch her sit by the window for hours, just staring at the rainbows.#$b#Thank you. Really.#$b#...#$b#...#$b#...I miss her every day, kid.#$b#Every single day.#$b#...#$b#...#$b#I need time... alone.$h
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgeCoffee: Kid,^^My old joints are aching something terrible today. A hot cup of Coffee usually helps get my body working again.^^Bring me a cup, if you have the time.^^- George^^%item quest LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgeCoffeeQuest%%[#]Letter from George

ItemDelivery/Morning Coffee/George needs a cup of Coffee to help get his body working again./Bring George 1 Coffee./George (O)395 1/-1/200/-1/true/Ah... that hits the spot.#$b#Thanks. You're not so bad after all.$h
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynSunflo: Hello dear,^^You know, a nice, happy Sunflower would really cheer up the living room!^^If you happen to grow any on your farm, could you bring one to an old lady?^^- Evelyn^^%item quest LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynSunflowerQuest%%[#]Letter from Evelyn

ItemDelivery/Splash of Yellow/Evelyn would like a Sunflower to brighten up her living room./Bring Evelyn 1 Sunflower./Evelyn (O)421 1/-1/200/-1/true/Oh, what a beautiful, sunny flower! It smells delightful.#$b#Thank you so much for bringing this to me, dear.$h
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynTheGol: My dearest dear,^^I know this is a terribly strange request from an old lady, but please hear me out!^^Years and years ago, when I was a little girl, my grandmother kept a beautiful golden pumpkin on the porch. It shone like the sun every morning.^^I thought she was the luckiest woman in the world.^^If you ever happen to find or grow a Golden Pumpkin, would you bring it to me? I just... I would love to sit with it and remember her.^^All my love,^^- Evelyn^^%item quest LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynTheGoldenPumpkinQuest%%[#]Letter from Evelyn

ItemDelivery/Grandmother's Golden Table/Evelyn would love a Golden Pumpkin to remember her grandmother by./Bring Evelyn 1 Golden Pumpkin./Evelyn (O)373 1/-1/2500/-1/true/Oh, my heart!#$b#Just look at it sitting there...#$b#Thank you, dear. This means a lot to me.$h
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgeRabbit: Alex has been having some rough days lately. He doesn't say much, but I can tell. The kid works harder than anyone, and he still gets so down on himself sometimes.^^I'm not one for sentimental nonsense, but I heard a rabbit's foot is supposed to bring good luck. The real kind. The soft, fluffy kind.^^If you've got a rabbit on that farm of yours... well. Maybe a lucky charm wouldn't hurt.^^- George^^%item quest LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgeRabbitsFootQuest%%[#]Letter from George

ItemDelivery/Lucky Charm/George wants a Rabbit's Foot to secretly give to Alex as a good-luck charm./Bring George 1 Rabbit's Foot./George (O)446 1/-1/300/-1/true/...It's softer than I expected.#$b#Good. That's... that's good.#$b#The kid needs to catch a break. This'll help. Probably just nonsense, but...#$b#...Hmph. You didn't hear me say any of that.$h
LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgeSlimeQ: My TV has been acting up, full of annoying static at night.^^I read in an old magazine that it could be caused by an overpopulation of Slimes in the local caves disrupting the magnetic field.^^Do me a favor and head into the mines to slay 5 of those things. I need some peace and quiet.^^- George^^%item quest LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_GeorgeSlimeQuest%%[#]Letter from George

LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynTapper: My dearest dear,^^George and I took a walk through the forest recently, and he remarked how much he missed the taste of fresh Maple Syrup.^^I'd love to tap a tree for him, but I'm afraid I don't have the strength to make the tool. Could you perhaps craft or find a Tapper and bring it to me?^^- Evelyn^^%item quest LucyTheDove.EvelynExpansion_EvelynTapperQuest%%[#]Letter from Evelyn

ItemDelivery/Sweet Maple/Evelyn would like to collect Maple Syrup for George, but she needs a Tapper./Bring Evelyn 1 Tapper./Evelyn (BC)105 1/-1/500/-1/true/Oh, what a sturdy little machine! I can't wait to set this up.#$b#Thank you so much, dear.$h
